newsitem.title: UK: Frost shares catch cold after selling.
newsitem.headline: Frost shares catch cold after selling.

text.p: Shares in Frost Group Plc were down 7p to 124-1/2p by 1145 GMT, after an individual seller disposed of a line of stock in an "amateurish" way, market makers said.
"There is no fundamental reason for the stock to be down. It really has been a case of poor dealing," one market maker said.
"It was a badly handled selling order -- some shocking dealing."
With only three market makers in the petroleum products retailer, disposing of a block of shares usually has to be handled with some finesse so as not to depress the share price.
But in this case the seller sold various amounts of Frost shares at various prices, in quick succession. "The tactic depressed the market somewhat," the market maker said.
Frost is due to announce its results for the year ended 31 December, 1996 on Friday, March 21.
